summary: Patterns only match what's in inventory; unknown hosts cause 'Could not match supplied host pattern' warnings, and aliased hosts must be targeted by alias, not their ansible_host IP.
questions: Why do I get Could not match supplied host pattern?
Can I target a host by its IP if inventory uses an alias?
Why does Ansible say only implicit localhost is available?

answer_card.title: Pattern limitations
answer_card.answer_md:
Patterns can only target hosts and groups in your inventory. Otherwise you'll see:
```text
[WARNING]: Could not match supplied host pattern, ignoring: *.not_in_inventory.com
```
If a host is defined by alias (`host1` with `ansible_host: 127.0.0.2`), you must use `host1`; using `127.0.0.2` gives the same warning.
